rules.rule: Render films one at a time, not in parallel.
Do not rebuild the Kurva S files.
For the TTS & TAS group assignment, do not write its content or build its files; give review and advice only.
When rebuilding the PDF of this report, first save the document in Word (SaveAs), then export the PDF from that Word-saved docx.
Before editing a revised assignment file in the "File terpisah (tidak diunggah)" folder, first copy the file as a backup.
Never place the assignment files, which contain the student's NIM and date of birth, in the JARVIS repository.
Until a voice lock exists, run only one voice batch at a time.
Render films one at a time.
Before running `buat_seragam.py`, move existing output files with the same names to `_Arsip\`, because the script overwrites them.
If the YouTube Data API key is used, store it in a user environment variable, never in the public repo.
Before running the build scripts, move existing same-named output files to `_Arsip\` so they are not overwritten.
Before running the sticker build script, move the existing sticker versions to the `_Arsip\` folder so they are not overwritten.
Use the Preview JPG only for viewing, never for printing.
Never save Bryan's coursework materials or tugas into JARVIS\kuliah\.
Do not run `unggah-sekitar` during a film session.
Before uploading anything as the @rupanya.gini account, read the reference-upload-route memory file.
Do not change Windows Firewall rules yourself; leave the admin PowerShell firewall commands for the user to run.
Never move the GP-100\ folder, which holds the installed GP-100 editor app.
Before setting a rebuilt film on a site, compare its SHA-256 with `sha256sum` of the original file.
Before uploading to YouTube, check that the channel avatar is the orange "r." / Rupanya Gini channel.
Settle every TikTok post detail before pressing Schedule, because scheduled posts cannot be edited.
Never name a script inspect.py, because it shadows the standard library module.
Do not record Bryan's exact personal financial figures in this public repo; ask him for them when they are needed.
Do not open YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or Meta Business Suite to post or schedule a film.
Do not call `pipeline_update` with stage `upload` during a film session.
Do not use an autotest run on a silent desktop to measure or verify audio; the absence of sound in that case proves nothing.
Keep `info()` callbacks as pure memory access, since they run on the render thread at 60 Hz; never run system probes in them.
Before starting a session, identify the registered server-side entity `01` (listed via `GET /clients`) and delete it using `proximus_delete()`.
Do not implement the :base+15 SSH+SFTP channel (libssh, curve25519, ed25519) in the Switch port.
Do not pursue further reverse-engineering follow-up on the TIER5-B1 Capabilities advertisement axis; it is closed.
Do not search for a port for ComChan, since it has no socket.
Do not migrate the WebRTC stack to libdatachannel to work around the Switch freeze bug.
Do not retest the 14 hypotheses listed as eliminated in this investigation.
Do not re-test the RFC 7675 consent freshness hypothesis for the t=115 s freeze.
Do not re-test the hypotheses already eliminated in the WebRTC freeze investigation at t=120s.
Before running any debugging campaign on the console, run `SHADOW_NATIVE=1 ./shadow-client` on Linux against the same VM to try to reproduce the defect.
Do not copy libnxbox.
After testing N1+N2, if the freeze persists, implement N3 (TWCC v2 and simplified GoogCC).
Push the Switch build only after the machine has been rebooted.
Before testing more VST connect body variants, capture the plaintext `SSL_write` on the desktop side with an LD_PRELOAD hook to lock the body byte-exact.
Do not implement a new trigger for TIER 9 to expose the streaming-profile speed/reliability preset.
Run the duplicate-send test (option 3) to confirm the packet-loss hypothesis before investing in the SACK-buffer-and-retransmit implementation (option 1).
Before working on the Shadow port, always first validate the environment by checking the toolchain, a hello-world build, and nxlink.
When first writing a crypto, SUFP, or CtrlChanV2 module on the Switch side, read the corresponding section of the full ENCRYPTION_AND_FRAMING.md document first.
Do not modify the profile-level-id handling in h264_decoder.c during M13 or later polish work.
Do not modify the AU aggregation strategy in h264_decoder.c during M13 or later polish work.
Start the video stream (SPICE port 6000) only after /status reports streamer_up:true.
Do not pivot to ngtcp2/QUIC on the Switch; do not port a QUIC stack there.

When a Switch homebrew app fails on system initialization (e.g., curl_global_init, nifm, or socket init) without a crash, ask for a full console reboot and retest before debugging code diffs or suspecting a newly linked library.
For the Switch port, do not implement QUIC support.
